sn35.241:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ajjheyaṃ viharati gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
sn35.241:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre sotena vuyhamānaṃ
sn35.241:1.4: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amuṃ mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānanti.
sn35.241:1.6: sace kho bhikkhave dārukkhandho na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchati na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchati na majjhe saṃsīdissati na thale ussādissati na manussaggāho gāhiyati na amanussaggāho gāhiyati na āvaṭṭaggāho gāhiyati na antopūti bhavissati.
sn35.241:1.7: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave dārukkhandho samuddaninno bhavissati samuddapoṇo samuddapabbhāro.
sn35.241:1.9: samuddaninno bhikkhave gaṅgāya nadiyā soto samuddapoṇo samuddapabbhāro.
sn35.241:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave sace tumhepi na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchatha
sn35.241:2.2: na majjhe saṃsīdissatha na thale ussādissatha. na manussaggāho gāhiyati na amanussaggāho gāhiyati na āvaṭṭaggāho gāhiyati na antopūti bhavissati.
sn35.241:2.3: evaṃ tumhe bhikkhave nibbānaninnā bhavissatha nibbānapoṇā nibbānapabbhārā.
sn35.241:2.6: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.241:2.7: kiṃ nu kho bhante orimaṃ tīraṃ kiṃ pārimaṃ tīraṃ ko majjhe saṃsīdito ko thale ussādo ko manussaggāho ko amanussaggāho ko āvaṭṭaggāho ko antopūtibhāvoti.
sn35.241:3.1: orimaṃ tīranti kho bhikkhu channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:3.2: pārimaṃ tīranti kho bhikkhu channetaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:3.3: majjhe saṃsīditoti kho bhikkhu nandirāgassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:3.4: thale ussādoti kho bhikkhu asmimānassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:4.2: idha bhikkhu gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandi sahasokī sukhitesu sukhito dukkhitesu dukkhito uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attano yogaṃ āpajjati.
sn35.241:5.2: idha bhikkhu ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vattena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti.
sn35.241:5.4: āvaṭṭaggāhoti kho bhikkhu pañcannetaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
sn35.241:6.2: idha bhikkhu ekacco dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakammanto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacārīpaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambukajāto.
sn35.241:7.1: tena kho pana samayena nando gopālako bhagavato avidūre ṭhito hoti.
sn35.241:7.2: atha kho nando gopālako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.241:7.3: ahaṃ kho bhante na orimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchāmi na pārimaṃ tīraṃ upagacchāmi na majjhe saṃsīdissāmi na thale osīdissāmi na manussaggāho gāhiyati na amanussaggāho gāhiyati na āvaṭṭaggāho gāhiyati na antopūti bhavissāmi. sādhu
sn35.241:7.4: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn35.241:7.5: tenahi tvaṃ nanda sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyādehīti.
sn35.241:7.8: atha kho nando gopālako sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyādetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.241:7.10: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn35.241:7.11: alattha kho nando gopālako bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadanti.
sn35.241:7.12: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā nando eko vūpakaṭṭho …pe…
sn35.241:7.13: aññataro ca panāyasmā nando arahataṃ ahosīti.
